semantics.clock: State updates on rising clk edge, conventional interpretation of the clocked synchronous FSM.
semantics.reset: problem.txt: active-high synchronous reset to OFF; reset overrides j and k at rising edge.

transitions.OFF: j=0 holds OFF; j=1 enters ON; k irrelevant
transitions.ON: k=0 holds ON; k=1 enters OFF; j irrelevant

semantics.output: problem.txt: Moore output, OFF out=0 and ON out=1; reflects current state without extra latency.
semantics.initialization: No initial state specified in problem.txt; no declaration initialization; verification asserts behavior only after first reset edge.
semantics.between_edges: Inputs and reset cannot change state between rising edges.

numeric.arithmetic: None; all ports and state are single-bit unsigned.

verification.oracle: Independent output-state recurrence from original OFF/ON transition diagram.
verification.sampling: Drive on falling edge; check before rising edge and after NBA settling; check falling edge stability.
verification.coverage: All input combinations from both states; synchronous reset asserted between edges in ON; all reset input combinations; extended deterministic sequence.
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS only after completion.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Power-up state and X/Z inputs unspecified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No power-up initialization or guarantees for unknown inputs; functional checks use binary inputs after reset.
